hooks.command: sh -c 'cd "${GEMINI_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 1; d=$(pwd); until [ -x "$d/node_modules/.bin/agnostic-ai" ] || [ -f "$d/agnostic-ai.yaml" ] || [ -f "$d/agnostic.config.yaml" ] || [ "$d" = "$(dirname "$d")" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; bin="$d/node_modules/.bin/agnostic-ai"; [ -x "$bin" ] || bin=agnostic-ai; command -v "$bin" >/dev/null || exit 0; AGNOSTIC_AI_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 "$bin" project --help >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "agnostic-ai: this version has no project command; upgrade to 0.83.0 or newer" >&2; exit 1; }; exec "$bin" project -- hook memory --target gemini'
hooks.description: Load the shared memory index into the session.
